title: Rethinking Prompt-based Debiasing in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype and bias detection in religious contexts. The paper evaluates whether models rely on stereotypes when contexts are ambiguous and whether they incorrectly identify bias in contexts that are explicitly unbiased.
findings: Based on the self-diagnosis task using the BBQ dataset, models showed a high probability of identifying bias in ambiguous contexts related to religion. However, they also demonstrated a high false-positive rate, frequently misclassifying unbiased (disambiguated) content involving religion as biased, suggesting an over-sensitivity to keywords rather than a deep understanding.
